mapper.sql: id, event_key, event_type, sub_event_type, payload_json, execute_status, execute_count, next_execute_at, lock_owner, lock_until, last_error_code, last_error_summary, lock_version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_compensation_event ( id, event_key, event_type, sub_event_type, payload_json, execute_status, execute_count, next_execute_at, lock_owner, lock_until, last_error_code, last_error_summary, lock_version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{eventKey}, #{eventType}, #{subEventType}, #{payloadJson}, 'INIT', 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_compensation_event WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: UPDATE t_compensation_event SET execute_status = 'PROCESSING', execute_count = execute_count + 1, lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, lock_until = TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{leaseMicros}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: WHERE id = #{eventId} AND execute_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner IS NOT NULL AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_rows, COALESCE( GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, MIN(create_time), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), 0), 0 ) AS oldest_pending_micros, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN execute_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner IS NOT NULL AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS expired_lease_rows FROM t_compensation_event
mapper.update: UPDATE t_compensation_event SET execute_status = 'ERROR', next_execute_at = TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{delayMicros}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), lock_owner = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_summary = #{errorSummary}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND execute_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner = #{lockOwner} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE t_compensation_event SET execute_status = 'FAILED', lock_owner = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_summary = #{errorSummary}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND execute_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lock_owner = #{lockOwner} AND lock_version = #{lockVersion} AND lock_until IS NOT NULL AND lock_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE t_compensation_event SET execute_status = 'ERROR', execute_count = 0, next_execute_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), lock_owner = NULL, lock_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_summary = NULL, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND execute_status = 'FAILED' AND lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} AND lock_owner IS NULL AND lock_until IS NULL
